meta.name: phase3e-prompt-v1.1.1-acceptance
meta.tolerance: score ranges ±0.10; labels/skip reasons exact; no metric drop >0.10 unless targeted
meta.note: All ranges are design hypotheses, not validated objective thresholds.

cases.input: v1.0.0 Pilot answer; Human Gold Q23 final question/answer
must: Correctness wrong_facts contains the positive conclusion
Faithfulness conclusion is factual_claim, not non_factual; is_contradictory=true; contradiction_with non-empty
cases.no_regression: v1.0.0 correctness 0.8 must drop to <=0.3; relevancy not below 0.7

cases.focus: 发货时效 vs 到货时间
cases.input: v1.0.0 Pilot answer; Human Gold Q35 answer
must: correctness does not require transit time or region info not in gold
absence of transit time is not counted as supported factual claim
cases.no_regression: v1.0.0 correctness 0.3 must rise to >=0.7; no new wrong_facts

cases.input: v1.0.0 Pilot answer; Human Gold Q36 answer

expected.answer_correctness: 0.5-0.6 (v1.0.0 answer lacks conflict disclosure); 0.9-1.0 if disclosure added

must: no forced canonical choice; disclosure of §1/§12 conflict is not a wrong fact
missing conflict disclosure goes to missing_points, not wrong_facts
conflict disclosure meta claim is not marked contradictory

cases.input: Q21 Pilot answer; claim '质量问题不受 7 天无理由限制'

cases.focus: 合理操作建议 vs 规范性要求
cases.input: Q11 Pilot answer; Human Gold Q11 answer
must: '需提供照片/视频凭证' is factual_claim; if context lacks it -> insufficient_evidence
pure advice '建议联系客服' is non_factual and excluded from denominator
cases.no_regression: v1.0.0 faithfulness 0.8 should stay within 0.6-0.9, not drop below 0.5

cases.input: Q29 Pilot answer; Human Gold Q29 answer
must: Faithfulness does not return 1.0 for all-non_factual answers; exact skip reason no_scorable_claims
Correctness distinguishes correct refusal from wrong refusal
Relevancy does not require a yes/no conclusion
cases.no_regression: v1.0.0 relevancy 0.6 must rise to >=0.9; correctness 1.0 preserved
